en: Colorized vintage view over a small spa town nestled among wooded hills. In the foreground is a dark field with a light fence; behind it are many 19th‑century townhouses and larger spa buildings among trees. On the right stands a prominent church with a tall, slender spire and nearby historic-looking civic buildings. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors. At the top left the place name 'BAD ELSTER' is printed, and on one of the right-hand buildings the word 'ASTREA' is visible.
